g.text: Anterior cingulate cortex · hierarchical baseline DETECTION
One unexposed donor; physical sections model heterogeneity, not independent animals. All measured zeros retained.
Fixed μ~Beta(½,½), κ~LogNormal(log20,1.5);64×48 prior-quantile grid;8,192 seeded mixture draws. OOF prior-only groups=0/1280. No PM2.5 effect or new spatial resolution.
